tasks.purpose: 比较家庭出行方式的构成
tasks.setting:
The pie charts below show how journeys made by households in one town were distributed among four principal modes of transport in 2010 and 2020. Each percentage is a share of all journeys in the relevant year, not a count of travellers.

Pie charts: share of household journeys (%)
Mode          2010  2020
Car             50    40
Bus             20    25
Bicycle         10    15
Walking         20    20
bullets: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
must: 概括两年的出行方式构成及主要变化。
tasks.model:
The pie charts compare the proportions of household journeys made by four transport modes in a town in 2010 and 2020. The percentages refer to journeys rather than the number of people travelling.

Overall, cars accounted for the largest share in both years, although their proportion fell. Bus travel and cycling became more significant, while walking maintained the same share of the total.

In 2010, half of all journeys were made by car. Bus travel and walking each represented one fifth, at 20%, while cycling was the least common mode at 10%. Thus the car share was two and a half times that of either buses or walking, and five times the figure for bicycles.

By 2020, the car share had declined by ten percentage points to 40%. It nevertheless remained the largest category, exceeding the bus figure of 25% by 15 percentage points. Bus travel had gained five points over the decade, and cycling had also risen by five points, reaching 15%. Walking remained unchanged at 20%. As a result, the three non-car modes together represented 60% of journeys in 2020, compared with 50% in 2010.

tasks.purpose: 比较图书馆经费的构成
tasks.setting:
The pie charts below show the allocation of one library's annual budget among four categories in 2015 and 2025. The percentages refer to the share of the budget in each year and do not indicate whether the total amount of money changed.

Pie charts: share of annual budget (%)
Category       2015  2025
Staff            40    35
Books            30    25
Building         20    20
Digital          10    20
bullets: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
must: 概括两年预算的构成及主要变化。
tasks.model:
The pie charts illustrate how a library divided its annual budget among staff, books, the building and digital services in 2015 and 2025. The data are proportions of each year's budget rather than amounts of money.

Overall, staff accounted for the largest share in both years, although this proportion declined. Digital services gained the most ground and, by 2025, had the same share as the building. The chart does not establish whether actual expenditure rose or fell.

In 2015, 40% of the budget was allocated to staff, making this category ten percentage points larger than books, at 30%. The building received 20%, while digital services had the smallest share, at 10%. Together, staff and books accounted for 70% of the budget that year.

Ten years later, the proportions for staff and books had each fallen by five percentage points, to 35% and 25% respectively. The building's share was unchanged at one fifth. In contrast, the digital share doubled to 20%, an increase of ten percentage points. Staff and books still made up a majority, but their combined share had decreased to 60%.
